close_reason: Gap documented in PLAN.md §Known Limitations #2: headers/language/location require raw &[u8] bytes not passed to part_to_jmap; this bead IS the tracking issue
description:
**What:** File a tracked gap issue documenting that part_to_jmap cannot
populate EmailBodyPart.headers, .language, or .location because its signature
does not accept the raw message bytes (&[u8]) needed to extract per-part
headers.

**Algorithm:**
1. Read crate-jmap-mime/src/lib.rs and find the comment:
     // headers, language, location: require raw bytes; left as None/empty.
   Note its exact line number.
2. Read jmap-mail-types EmailBodyPart definition and confirm headers,
   language, location are real fields that RFC 8621 §4.1.4 defines.
3. Read ParsedPart.header_range field — this provides the byte offsets
   into the original raw message that cover this part's headers.
4. Create a standalone Beads issue titled:
     'jmap-mime: part_to_jmap cannot populate headers/language/location'
   with priority P3, type task, description covering:
   - The current function signature: pub fn part_to_jmap(part: &ParsedPart, blob_id_for: impl Fn(&ParsedPart) -> Id) -> EmailBodyPart
   - Why raw bytes are needed: headers requires slicing raw[part.header_range.0..], language/location parse specific header values from that slice
   - Fix options:
     (a) Add a third parameter: raw: &[u8] (breaking change to public API)
     (b) Add a new function part_to_jmap_with_headers(part, raw, blob_id_for)
     (c) Return a builder/struct that callers can augment (more complex)
   - The RFC 8621 fields affected: headers (EmailHeader[]), language (String[]), location (String)
   - RFC 8621 §4.1.4 default bodyProperties does NOT include headers or subParts,
     so many callers will not need these — option (b) may be sufficient

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Tracking issue only — no code changes.
- Cite exact line numbers.

**Subagent instructions:**
Single subagent reads src/lib.rs and jmap-mail-types EmailBodyPart fields,
then writes the issue.

**Tests:** N/A

**Acceptance criteria:**
- New Beads issue created with exact title.
- Cites the comment line number.
- Lists all three missing fields with their RFC 8621 types.
- Presents at least two fix options with trade-offs.
title: jmap-mime gap: headers/language/location API design
